items.title: The candidate nobody saw coming
items.sponsor_flag: Metaview (fillmore) sponsor block; vendor self-promotion, flagged

points.claim: Hires who were not flagged Standout by recruiter or hiring manager may reveal screening weaknesses
points.quote: Maybe our original screening criteria were too narrow. Maybe, as we all know, we’re placing too much weight on what’s on the CV/Resume.

points.claim: Proposes investigating the share of eventual hires never flagged early
points.evidence: Posed as a question, no figure given
points.quote: What if you discover that a meaningful proportion of eventual hires weren’t initially flagged as Standout by either the recruiter or the hiring manager?

points.claim: Unhired Standout candidates could feed talent rediscovery
points.quote: For me, it’s even better than the current silver medalist model.

points.claim: Standout sits between finding talent and evidencing ability
points.evidence: Author framing; adoption claim has no number
points.quote: Standout sits between those two things.
